name: Summer Employment Program for Students
provider: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, Department of Jobs, Growth and Rural Development

summary.quote: The Summer Employment Program for Students (SEPS) provides funding to assist private sector businesses and not‐for‐profit organizations create summer employment for students (post-secondary or high school).

sources.title: Summer Employment Program for Students - Jobs, Growth and Rural Development
sources.terms_note: The province owns the copyright and grants the public permission to use the information on its website; third-party graphics, audio and video may not be reproduced.

funding_types.quote: Private Sector employers are eligible to receive a maximum subsidy of $4,032 per each full-time equivalent approval.

max_amount.text: Private sector employers: up to $4,032 per full-time equivalent approval
max_amount.quote: Private Sector employers are eligible to receive a maximum subsidy of $4,032 per each full-time equivalent approval.

criteria.text: A private sector employer (incorporated or sole proprietorship) or a not-for-profit organization
criteria.quote: Private Sector employers (incorporated or sole proprietorship). Not-for-profit organizations, school districts and municipalities.

criteria.text: The employer has an office or base in Newfoundland and Labrador
criteria.quote: Have an office location or base in Newfoundland and Labrador.

criteria.text: The money is for hiring students for the summer
criteria.quote: create summer employment for students (post-secondary or high school)

criteria.text: Has a Canada Revenue Agency business number
criteria.quote: Have a Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) business number.

criteria.text: If incorporated, in good standing with Company and Deeds Online (CADO)
criteria.quote: Be in good standing with Company and Deeds Online (CADO), if incorporated.

criteria.text: The student isn't an immediate family member of the employer
criteria.quote: Not be an immediate family member of the employer as defined in the Terms and Conditions.

research.notes: The old URL /jgrd/summer-employment-program-for-students/ redirects on the same host to /jgrd/students/summer-employment-program-for-students/, which was fetched directly. Intake: the page gives 'APPLICATION DEADLINE is February 19, 2026', so the stated status is open with that deadline; core closes it because the date has passed ('The deadline on the page has passed'). When the page announces the 2027 intake, the record needs updating. Amount: private sector employers up to $4,032 per full-time equivalent; not-for-profits up to $7,800 (kept in notes; the record shows the business amount). Structure: private sector employers that are incorporated or sole proprietorships, and not-for-profit organizations, so corporation, sole_proprietor and nonprofit; a co-operative may be either, so unclear; partnerships miss. The student rules (returning to school, legally entitled to work) are for the student and are summarised by the family-member item only. The Program Guidelines and Terms and Conditions were not fetched.
